players.product: MEMS-based OCS switch (optical circuit switch manufacturer, Wuhan, China)

quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 results (half-year report): revenue RMB 6.61 billion, up 26.07% YoY from RMB 5.24 billion; net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 582.18 million, up 56.34%; net profit excluding non-recurring items RMB 568.00 million, up 57.77%; net profit excluding share-based payment RMB 636.02 million (+50.55%). Communications equipment manufacturing gross margin 25.50% (+2.99 points). Operating cash flow was an outflow of RMB 1.24 billion (versus an outflow of RMB 107.32 million), mainly from higher operating cash outflows; asset impairment of RMB 193.55 million, mainly inventory write-down provisions.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 revenue RMB 6.61 billion (+26.07%); net profit RMB 582.18 million (+56.34%); gross margin 25.50%

quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 revenue by product (half-year report): transmission products RMB 2.28 billion, up 50.51%, 34.55% of revenue, gross margin 28.83% (+0.45 points); data and access products RMB 4.31 billion, up 16.01%, 65.21% of revenue (70.86% a year earlier), gross margin 23.57% (+3.61 points). By region: overseas RMB 2.27 billion, up 73.79%, 34.41% of revenue (24.96% a year earlier), gross margin 23.31% (-5.69 points); domestic RMB 4.34 billion, up 10.20%, gross margin 26.69% (+6.34 points).
quarterly_data.figure: transmission RMB 2.28 billion (+50.51%); data and access RMB 4.31 billion (+16.01%); overseas RMB 2.27 billion (+73.79%)

quarterly_data.signal: Balance sheet at June 30, 2026 (half-year report): inventory RMB 9.07 billion (39.39% of total assets, from RMB 5.75 billion at end-2025), mainly from stocking up for market demand; prepayments RMB 915.08 million (from RMB 106.19 million), mainly purchase prepayments, with the top five prepaid suppliers holding 96.98% of the balance (the largest 54.07%, names not disclosed); contract liabilities RMB 1.15 billion (from RMB 431.12 million) on larger sales; other non-current assets up on equipment prepayments.
quarterly_data.figure: inventory RMB 9.07 billion; prepayments RMB 915.08 million; contract liabilities RMB 1.15 billion

quarterly_data.signal: Products and position (half-year report): datacom modules cover 400G, 800G and 1.6T with LRO/LPO low-power options and coherent modules for DCI; the company says it is laying out large-port-count optical circuit switches (OCS) and next-generation NPO and XPO high-speed interconnect for AI computing clusters; transmission includes 400G and 800G digital coherent (DCO) pluggables with flexible-grid tuning and WSS; access includes 50G PON and early 6G-related modules. The company cites Omdia: in Q2 2025 to Q1 2026 it ranked fifth in global optical components with a 5.1% share (datacom fourth at 4.7%, telecom fifth at 5.7%, access third at 8.3%, up one place). It says it remained a core supplier to leading domestic customers with a leading tender share in key products. H1 R&D investment RMB 617.29 million (+25.76%); 108 domestic patent applications and 6 PCT international-phase patents.
quarterly_data.figure: 400G/800G/1.6T modules; OCS, NPO, XPO in development; 5.1% global optical component share, fifth (Omdia); R&D RMB 617.29 million (+25.76%)

quarterly_data.signal: Capacity projects (half-year report): the new raised-fund computing-center optical connection and high-speed optical transmission product production project (infrastructure) has a committed investment of RMB 207,383.55 ten-thousand, 9.53% invested (RMB 19,763.88 ten-thousand) at June 30, 2026, scheduled to reach usable state on July 31, 2028; a high-speed optical interconnect and emerging optoelectronics R&D project (RMB 61,442.95 ten-thousand) is scheduled for April 30, 2028. The earlier high-end optical communication device production project (usable since September 30, 2025) delivered benefits of RMB 32,568.85 ten-thousand in H1 2026; the high-end optoelectronic device R&D center reached usable state. Construction in progress rose to RMB 201.47 million, mainly new factory construction: New Industrial Park Phase II, budget RMB 604,640,500.00, 29.03% complete, funded by raised funds.
quarterly_data.figure: production project RMB 207,383.55 ten-thousand, 9.53% invested, usable by July 31, 2028; Industrial Park Phase II 29.03%
